intent: Consolidate the previously reviewed Helm stack onto current canonical main as one mechanical draft PR, preserving the exact terminal, bridge, provider-preview, and Slice-1 HelmContextEnvelope behavior while removing branch-only custody artifacts that current repository policy forbids: the temporary root build-status file and superseded historical Session Entry packets. This packet is the single current event-scope authority envelope; it grants no merge authority and introduces no new product behavior beyond the recovered stack.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('dharma_swarm/operator_core/helm_context.py'); t=p.read_text(); old='if reject_reserved and normalized in _RESERVED_PROJECTION_KEYS:'; new='if False and normalized in _RESERVED_PROJECTION_KEYS:'; (t.count(old) == 1) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(old,new,1)); ns={}; exec(compile(p.read_text(),str(p),'exec'),ns); fn=ns['_validate_json_value']; sys.exit(1 if fn({'provider_state_promotion': True},path='projection',reject_reserved=True) else 2)"
negative_controls.name: helm-context-authority-forgery-is-rejected

honest_blockers: This consolidation remains a draft and cannot merge until every required CI context is green and the operator explicitly approves the merge.
The packet proves committed-range scope and declared gates; it does not prove seven fresh live model receipts or satisfy the full Helm leg-one alive bar.
Fugu Ultra and other preview routes remain subject to their actual client, credential, and response-owned identity evidence; registration or preview code is not live proof.
interface_mismatches: The recovered stack arrived as eight historical Session Entry packets, while current CI requires exactly one packet to cover one high-risk pull-request event.
The recovered stack included HELM_SELF_AWARE_BUILD_STATUS.md at repository root even though its own source notes said to leave that temporary checkpoint uncommitted and Rule 8 forbids the location.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this governance-repair commit to restore the pre-repair branch; terminal behavior is unchanged by the repair itself.
